name: PlanC_01_Cinematic_Portrait
category: 超真实人像与微表情测试
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic portrait, 35mm master film stock: natural daylight, soft diffused window light, shallow depth of field (f/1.4), ultra-high fidelity skin pores, individual loose hair strands moving in breeze, realistic eye micro-saccades, subtle facial muscle tension, muted cinematic teal-and-orange color grading.

Scene: An emotional close-up dialogue sequence in a quiet morning coffee shop.

Timeline:
[0s-1.5s] Extreme close-up of a young woman's eyes, looking down pensively, subtle reflection of rainfall on the glass window in her pupils.
[1.5s-3s] She slowly lifts her gaze directly into camera, a gentle, bittersweet micro-smile forms at the corner of her lips, a deep breath causes her chest and shoulders to subtly rise.
[3s-5s] Cut to medium close-up, wind from the opening door softly ruffles her stray bangs, natural optical bokeh behind her.

Camera: Smooth slow push-in, stable optical stabilization, no jarring shakes.

Audio: Gentle room acoustic ambience, distant muffled rain against glass, a soft mechanical sound of a ceramic coffee cup placed on wood, delicate human breathing audio in high-fidelity stereo.

Negative: No plastic or waxy skin, no uncanny valley, no over-smoothing, no cartoon or CGI 3D render look, no distorted pupils or extra teeth, no watermark or text subtitles.

name: PlanC_02_Cyberpunk_Rain
category: 极限光影与流体动力学测试
prompt:
Ultra-realistic neo-noir cyberpunk city street, anamorphic cinema lens, rain-slicked asphalt road reflecting vibrant neon signs (cyan, magenta, amber), volumetric steam rising from street manholes, heavy raindrops creating ripple rings in puddles.

Scene: A futuristic motorcycle arriving at a dark alley entrance at midnight.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] Low-angle tracking shot along wet asphalt, raindrops hitting the lens briefly before beading off, twin holographic headlights sweep across neon puddles.
[2s-3.5s] A sleek carbon-fiber motorcycle slows to a stop, tires cutting through water with fine mist splashing realistically sideways, brake calipers glowing faint orange.
[3.5s-5s] Rider in matte black helmet puts a leather-gloved boot down onto the wet ground, water ripples distorting the neon billboard reflections.

Camera: Low-angle tracking shot followed by a cinematic Dutch tilt hold. Clean hard cuts.

Audio: Heavy continuous rain ambience, stereo tires splashing through wet water puddles, futuristic electric motor high-pitched whine winding down, distant low synth bass droning in background.

Negative: No blurry reflections, no morphing wheels, no unrealistic water physics, no washed-out contrast, no cartoon shader.

name: PlanC_03_Macro_Nature
category: BBC 8K 微距生态纪录片细节测试
prompt:
BBC Earth style 8K macro documentary cinematography, 100mm macro lens with extreme optical sharpness, vivid natural lighting, microscopic depth of field with creamy background blur.

Scene: A crystalline dewdrop hanging on a delicate green fern leaf as a golden morning sunbeam strikes it.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] Microscopic view of a trembling transparent dewdrop, internally refracting the sunrise into a miniature rainbow spectrum, tiny surface tension wobbles visible.
[2s-3.5s] A ladybug with glossy red wing covers and crisp black spots crawls slowly onto the edge of the leaf, its tiny legs and antennae articulating naturally.
[3.5s-5s] The dewdrop reaches critical mass and detaches, falling in crisp slow-motion, the leaf bouncing back gracefully from the released weight.

Camera: Super-telephoto macro static focus, minute fluid rack-focus when the droplet falls.

Audio: Pristine natural forest ambience, crisp microscopic drop falling sound with delicate chime resonance, faint distant morning birdsong at 32kHz fidelity.

Negative: No muddy textures, no AI crawling artifacts on insect legs, no clipping, no over-sharpening halos.

name: PlanC_04_Auto_Commercial
category: 商业奢华工业材质与超跑动力学测试
prompt:
High-end commercial car advertisement look, ARRI Alexa 65 capture, high-contrast studio-to-exterior transitional lighting, dramatic sweeping light streaks over matte titanium car bodywork.

Scene: A hypercar accelerating on a closed coastal mountain highway at dusk.

Timeline:
[0s-1.5s] Extreme close-up sliding shot across the metallic badge and aggressive front carbon air intake, sharp studio rim-light glinting off the polished curve.
[1.5s-3s] Hard cut to wide tracking drone shot: the hypercar powering through an S-curve, dust drifting off the shoulder, sun flaring off the rear quarter panel.
[3s-5s] Hard cut to rear exhaust close-up, blue combustion flame pops during downshift, titanium exhaust tips vibrating with power.

Camera: High-speed Russian Arm chase-cam motion, snappy commercial cut on the beat.

Audio: High-fidelity twin-turbo V8 engine roar with deep rumbling low frequencies, turbo blow-off valve hiss at 2.5s, clean cinematic riser ending on a sharp hit.

Negative: No warped body lines, no inconsistent car proportions across shots, no text overlay, no artificial blur.

name: PlanC_05_Anime_Fantasy
category: 日系二次元奇幻与艺术张力测试
prompt:
High-budget anime theatrical movie style, Makoto Shinkai and Ufotable hybrid aesthetic: dynamic hand-drawn linework, glowing elemental particles, volumetric cumulus clouds under a golden hour sunset, rich chromatic gradient.

Scene: A young magical swordsman unleashing a burst of light atop a floating ruined shrine.

Timeline:
[0s-1.5s] Close-up on the hero's hand unsheathing an ancient blade, glowing runes activating along the steel with intense light streaks.
[1.5s-3.5s] High-angle dynamic pullback: golden elemental energy vortex erupts from the blade, wind whipping cape and hair in exaggerated anime keyframe arcs.
[3.5s-5s] Full explosion of magical petals and light rings sweeping outward into the sky, clouds parting to reveal a twin-ring eclipse.

Camera: Dramatic dynamic anime camera snap-zoom and rotational sweep.

Audio: Shinkai-style soaring orchestral strings, metallic blade unsheathing shimmer, massive stereo magical blast hit at 3.5s with acoustic reverb decay.

Negative: No messy 3D doll look, no inconsistent hands or face, no dull palette, no static slides.

name: PlanC_08_Stress_10s_Space_Opera
category: 极限时长与复杂分镜压力测试（10秒太空歌剧史诗）
prompt:
Epic cinematic hard sci-fi space opera, 70mm IMAX cinematography: photorealistic astronomical scale, realistic physics in vacuum, immense detail on titanium-alloy space station hull, solar array reflection, Earth visible in low orbit below, cinematic anamorphic lens flare.

Scene: A massive modular interstellar cruiser initiating planetary departure and warp acceleration.

Timeline:
[0s-2.5s] Extreme wide shot: Earth’s curved atmospheric limb glowing blue below, the colossal cruiser drifts silently across frame, maneuvering thrusters fire intermittent white bursts of gas.
[2.5s-5s] Cut to medium shot along the ship's superstructure: heavy mechanical gantry arms retracting, docking clamps unlocking with high-stress hydraulic vibration, warning beacons pulsing amber.
[5s-7.5s] Low-angle shot from under the main sub-light ion engines: twin primary reactor coils charge up with deep sapphire glow, plasma exhaust flares into intense blinding cyan plume.
[7.5s-10s] Extreme wide shot: cruiser accelerates gracefully into deep space, leaving a turbulent particle wake, stars stretching slightly as warp distortion begins, final silhouette against cosmic nebula.

Camera: Smooth cosmic macro-scale tracking, epic crane motion, clean hard cuts on orchestral accents, zero artificial handheld shake.

Audio: Realistic muffled vacuum acoustic design, interior ship cockpit deep low-frequency sub-bass hum, crisp hydraulic clamp release thuds, immense orchestral space opera horn riser peaking at 7.5s, fading into deep cosmic resonance for the final 1s.

Negative: No cartoonish CGI, no unrealistic fire in vacuum, no warped ship geometry, no text watermark, no pixelated nebula, no blurry stars.
